sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
Which emblem is printed on face L?
A. Bars
B. Triangle
C. Diamond
D. Sun
E. Cross
F. Circle
sample.analysis: Locate face L in the unfolded net. Its tile contains the Diamond emblem. Therefore the answer is C.
